title: Slovakian Cabbage Stir Fry
description: A spicy Slovakian-inspired stir fry made with cabbage and your choice of protein.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the Slovakian Sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender
Add the cabbage to the skillet and cook until it starts to soften
Add the spicy paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Continue cooking the cabbage until it is tender and slightly caramelized
Serve the cabbage stir fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
